about: RabbitMQ spans of contract 4.0 (contract/span-contract-amqp.md), written by make-amqp-spans.py from the contract, not recorded: no package emits them yet. Re-record from the Python package (QV-309) and keep the scenarios. Do not edit by hand.

scenarios.requeue-once: nack with requeue, redelivered with x-acquired-count 1, acked
scenarios.nack-loop: nacked with requeue 5 times on a queue with x-delivery-limit 2: never dead-lettered
scenarios.crash-loop: the consumer's connection drops 3 times, the queue dead-letters it (delivery_limit), acked on the DLQ
scenarios.rejected-to-dlq: reject without requeue, delivered on the DLQ with x-death reason rejected
scenarios.fanout: one publish to a fanout exchange, a copy delivered and acked on each of two queues
scenarios.publisher-retry: the same message_id published twice: two publishes, two deliveries, two acks
scenarios.unroutable: a mandatory publish no queue takes: a return, then an ok publish
scenarios.classic: a classic queue: nack with requeue, redelivered with no count, acked
scenarios.no-message-id: published, delivered and acked without a message_id
scenarios.consumer-timeout: the broker cancels the consumer (consumer timeout); redelivered and acked
